title: vtc-00: abstract type list is stale
description: draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md ~L143 abstract says 'four top-level data types ... plus the embedded VTCMediaState object'. Either list them correctly or drop the count and list from the abstract (abstracts needn't enumerate types).
